name: PopWheels
tagline: Battery swap network for New York City's delivery e-bikes.
about: PopWheels runs a network of battery swap cabinets across New York City so delivery riders can trade a drained e-bike battery for a charged one in seconds. Hardware, firmware and the rider app are built in-house in Brooklyn.

recharging_property.description: Battery swap cabinets. Each cabinet stores and recharges removable lithium-ion e-bike batteries at a public curbside or storefront location in New York City.
recharging_property.vehicles_served: Class 1 and 2 electric bicycles with removable batteries. Not road-registered motor vehicles.

production_property.description: No manufacturing or production equipment placed in service in 2025. Cabinets are assembled by a contract manufacturer.

research.description: In-house development of battery swap cabinet hardware, battery management firmware, and the rider app. Engineers in Brooklyn, NY.
